decisionsTitle: The headline numbers count everyone with a place: «Cine vine (150)» and the «Înscrieri» badge with a pill per group in progress
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02, from his phone, three messages.** Production is live and the 21 November race is full. The public page read «150 de înscriși din 150 de locuri — 134 de confirmați, 16 în curs de confirmare, 10 pe lista de așteptare» above a fold titled «Cine vine (134)», and the backoffice tab read «Înscrieri [134] [⏳ 10]». He wrote: «Păi da dar atunci numărul ăsta de 134 nu e accurate, pune-o și pe cei care trebuie să confirme înregistrarea». Asked whether to change the public title, the badge, or both: «Amândouă». Then, with a screenshot of the tab: «Tot pe acest pill trebuie să afișăm și pe cei care așteaptă confirmarea mailului sau semnarea declarației».

**Decision: a headline number that stands for «înscriși» is everyone with a place.** That is the allocator's occupied people — CONFIRMED, PENDING_DECLARATION, an open WAITLIST_OFFERED, a family's hold (§543) — the same people the places line on the event page and the card already count (§615). The split (confirmed / în curs de confirmare) stands beside the number. This amends §346's title (the confirmed) and §626's badge (the confirmed alone).

**The public «Cine vine» fold.** On a capped event whose cached public read knows the counts, `inProgress = taken − confirmed` (the places line's own «în curs de confirmare»). When it is above zero the title counts the confirmed plus them — «Cine vine (150)» — and the bold line under it reads «150 de înscriși — 134 de confirmați (120 cu numele afișat), 16 în curs de confirmare» / «150 registered — 134 confirmed (120 with their name shown), 16 completing their registration», each Romanian number in its own form (`countForm`) and the in-progress words the places line's own (`cta.fillInProgress`), so the page says one thing one way. With nothing in progress, on an uncapped event, when registration is not open (the door reads no counts then) or from a cache entry that predates the counts, the title and the line are exactly as before («Cine vine (134)», «134 de participanți confirmați — 120 cu numele afișat»). The figure comes from the same cached read the page's door already makes (`readRegistrationDoor` → `cachedPublicAvailability`): no query of the list's own, so the public cache keeps Neon as cheap as §250 and §333 made it. The confirmed in the title stays the list's own REAL-only count, while `taken − confirmed` is the places line's kind-blind count; on QA a TEST row can make the two reads differ, which §615's criterion 16 already accepts for the places line; production has no TEST row. The rows do not change: behind §396's gate the ticked pending appear by name with «Apar cu numele și: …», the waiting list stays behind §628's switch, and nobody pending appears without the gate. The note under the table now says the title's number includes, at an event with a set number of places and while registration is open, those completing their registration, and that the table lists the confirmed.

**Why an uncapped event keeps the confirmed alone.** §32 declined to publish a head count of held places with no «out of» beside it; an uncapped event shows no places line, so the page has no in-progress number to repeat, and the title would be the only place that discloses it.

**The backoffice «Înscrieri» tab.** The filled pill is everyone with a place at the upcoming events (`withPlace`, REAL rows only, from the query and the one-minute memo that exist). After it, outlined pills in the waiting pill's shape (glyph and number, a worded name for a screen reader, drawn only above zero, all inside the one focusable chunk the tooltip hangs on), in this order: those completing their registration with a place (`withPlace − confirmed`, the pen `Draw` the participant's own declaration step wears), those awaiting the email confirmation (`awaitingEmail`, the envelope `MarkEmailRead` of the email step), and the waiting list (the hourglass, as §626). «Înscrieri [150] [✍ 16] [✉ 7] [⏳ 10]». The first pill is part of the filled number; the other two are outside it. The two glyphs join the action-icon registry as `declaration` and `emailConfirmation`. The tooltip's first line says every figure, a zero included: «Cu loc: 150 — 134 de confirmați, 16 în curs de confirmare · așteaptă confirmarea emailului: 7 · pe lista de așteptare: 10»; the figures still add up to everybody with an active registration, and the per-event lines are unchanged.

**Why the pending email and the waiting list stay out of the headline.** A form whose address is not confirmed holds no place (unless a family's hold reserves one, which is counted), and the waiting list is not registered for a place either; counting them would make the badge disagree with the public places line and with the allocator. They have their own pills, beside the number and not inside it.

**Why the pills are not links.** The tab is already an anchor and a link inside an anchor is invalid HTML; the registrations list's summary strip is where the pills are filters (§626).

**Refused:** a new query for the public title (the cached read is enough); counting TEST rows anywhere a club reads (§12.6); words beside the tab's pills (three pills at 320 pixels lengthen the scrollable tab row, never the page, only while they stay glyph and number).
changelogLine: - **The headline numbers count everyone with a place** — on a capped event «Cine vine (150)» adds those completing their registration to the confirmed, with «150 de înscriși — 134 de confirmați (120 cu numele afișat), 16 în curs de confirmare» under it, and the backoffice «Înscrieri» badge is everyone with a place, followed by a pill each for those completing their registration, those awaiting the email confirmation and the waiting list. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 188. The «Înscrieri» tab's filled figure is the number of real registrations holding a place at the upcoming events (CONFIRMED, PENDING_DECLARATION, an unlapsed WAITLIST_OFFERED, a family's hold), never a test row; after it, outlined pills drawn only above zero, each a glyph and a number named for a screen reader and all inside the one focusable chunk, in this order: those with a place who are not confirmed (the pen), those awaiting the email confirmation (the envelope with the tick), the waiting list with a lapsed offer (the hourglass); none is a link; the tooltip's first line says the figure, its split into confirmed and completing their registration, the awaiting-email and the waiting figures, each present at zero and together the people with an active registration (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a capped event open for registration whose cached places read knows the confirmed count, when more places are taken than confirmed, then the list's title counts the confirmed plus those in progress («Cine vine (6)») and the line under it reads «6 înscriși — 4 confirmați (3 cu numele afișat), 2 în curs de confirmare» / «6 registered — 4 confirmed (3 with their name shown), 2 completing their registration», from the door's cached read with no query of its own; with nobody in progress, on an uncapped event, while registration is not open, or from a cache entry without the counts, the title and line are the confirmed alone as before; the rows and the §396 gate are unchanged (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
